## What's new


- Improved chart preview in regards to brawl notes
- Updated UNANIMATED integration
  - Changed the hint for using "|" symbols to separate items to ";" semicolons.
- Added new "Folder in Package" export option
  - (This option adds a folder into a zip file instead of just the chart files, compared to the normal Package option)
- "Export successfully!" messages now have a button to open the exported result in the file explorer
- Fixed the menues at the top of the editor always closing when pressing a toggle button

**Happy mapping!**
